channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Motta diz que queda do veto da dosimetria pode levar STF a rever penas
item.description: Hugo Motta, president of the Chamber of Deputies, states that the overthrow of the presidential veto on the Dosimetry Bill could lead the STF to reinterpret the sentences of those convicted for the January 8 acts, allowing prisoners to leave closed regime and serve sentences under other modalities. He calls the project a 'politically possible construction' to avoid institutional crisis and pacify the country after January 8, advocating that Congress must act responsibly in resolving the issue.

item.title: TSE deve definir na quinta como fica o governo de Roraima após cassação do governador
item.description: The TSE confirmed the removal of Governor Edilson Damião (União Brasil) and the eight-year ineligibility of former Governor Antonio Denarium (Republicanos) due to electoral crimes in the 2022 elections. The decision will be officially proclaimed on Thursday (30), after which new elections will be held in Roraima, with the state legislative assembly president assuming the governorship on an interim basis until the vote.

item.title: Senado analisa nesta quarta-feira indicação de Jorge Messias para vaga no STF; veja perfil
item.description: The Senate is reviewing on Wednesday (29) the nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), proposed by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva to fill the vacancy left by Luís Roberto Barroso. Messias, current Minister of the Attorney General's Office (AGU) and a Lula confidant since the Dilma Rousseff administration, will undergo a hearing in the Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) before a potential plenary vote. This marks Lula's third nomination to the STF.

item.title: Messias precisa de 41 votos no Senado para chegar ao STF; relembre outros placares
item.description: Jorge Messias, Brazil's Attorney General, needs 41 Senate votes to be confirmed to the Supreme Court following Lula's nomination for the vacancy left by Barroso. The vote will be secret and tight, with the government claiming 25 secured votes, 35 opposed, and 21 undecided. Recent nominations of Flávio Dino (47-31) and André Mendonça also passed by narrow margins, highlighting congressional polarization.

item.title: A uma semana do prazo para regularizar o título de eleitor, veja passo a passo para o processor
item.description: The deadline to regularize voter registration ends in one week, and those with irregular titles will be unable to vote in the October general elections or access public services such as public job applications, passports, or public school enrollment. The TSE offers free online consultation, and regularization can be completed via the Electoral Self-Service portal with tracking. The first round of elections is on October 4, with a potential runoff on October 25.

item.title: Sabatina, comissão e plenário: saiba o passo a passo no Senado para analisar indicação de Messias ao STF
item.description: Advocacy General Jorge Messias will undergo a Senate confirmation hearing in the Constitution and Justice Committee this Wednesday, followed by a floor vote, to be appointed as a new Supreme Court Justice replacing Luís Roberto Barroso. Approval requires a simple majority in both the committee and the full Senate via secret vote, after which his swearing-in can proceed.

item.title: Messias será sabatinado nesta quarta com disputa voto a voto entre governo e oposição
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias will face a confirmation hearing in the Senate’s Constitution and Justice Committee for a Supreme Court seat, with a secret ballot and a vote-by-vote contest between government and opposition. Approval in the committee requires a simple majority, but final confirmation in the plenary needs 41 senators, also by secret vote. Despite efforts by Senator Alcolumbre to block the nomination, Messias had an informal meeting with the Senate president and allies, described as a reunion of friends, though Alcolumbre has not publicly committed to supporting him.

item.title: Indicado por Lula ao STF, Messias chega hoje a sabatina no Senado com placar indefinido; veja enquete do GLOBO
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias faces an uncertain Senate hearing for his Supreme Court nomination, with 25 in favor, 22 against, and 34 undecided senators. Though government allies expect approval, the vote is seen as a gauge of Lula’s relationship with Congress, amid tensions with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and concerns over last-minute shifts.

item.title: Liderança de Lula no 1º turno e empate técnico com Flávio no 2º: o que diz nova AtlasIntel
item.description: Lula leads in the first round of the 2026 elections, while Flávio Bolsonaro is technically tied with him in a potential runoff, according to AtlasIntel. U.S. President Donald Trump announced that Iran contacted his government claiming to be in a 'state of collapse' and urged the U.S. Navy to lift its naval blockade on Iranian ships and ports in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Oposição diz ter votos para derrubar veto de Lula à Dosimetria
item.description: The opposition estimates it has enough votes to overturn Lula's veto on the Dosimetria bill, which reduces penalties for those involved in the January 8 acts and could benefit Bolsonaro. In the Chamber, 330 votes are projected (above the 257 needed), and in the Senate, 58 (above the 41 needed). Although the government claims it will uphold the veto, arguing it aligns with the Anti-Faction Law, behind the scenes defeat is already anticipated.

item.title: TSE deve concluir na quinta (30) julgamento do governador de Roraima
item.description: The TSE is set to conclude on Thursday (30) the trial that could remove Roraima's governor, Edilson Damião, after a 6x1 majority voted for his disqualification and the call for new elections. Minister André Mendonça is expected to present the remainder of his vote to finalize the outcome. Former governor Antonio Denarium has already been unanimously declared ineligible for eight years due to political and economic abuse in the 2022 elections.

item.title: Messias chega a sabatina para STF sob risco de derrota histórica e com incerteza sobre Alcolumbre
item.description: President Lula's nominee for the STF, Jorge Messias, faces uncertainty in the Senate hearing due to lack of explicit support from Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, putting his approval at risk and potentially leading to a historic defeat for the government.

item.title: Fachin teve sabatina para ministro do STF mais longa, e Cármen, a mais curta; veja histórico
item.description: Justice Edson Fachin had the longest confirmation hearing in STF history before the CCJ, while Justice Cármen Lúcia had the shortest. The article explains the Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) vetting process for Supreme Court nominees, highlighting variations in hearing length based on candidate and political context.

item.title: Governistas avaliam que Alcolumbre também perderia com rejeição de Messias e pedem bom senso
item.description: Allied senators of the Lula government say that rejecting Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF would harm not only the government and Messias himself, but also Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. They urge rationality in the vote, warning that defeat would carry broader political consequences.

item.title: PT tenta atrair Dorinha e Confúcio para fortalecer Lula no Norte
item.description: The PT is forming alliances in Brazil's North to bolster Lula's re-election bid, seeking support from Senator Professora Dorinha (União Brasil) in Tocantins and Senator Confúcio Moura (MDB) in Rondônia. PT Secretary-General Henrique Fontana states these talks prioritize a clear commitment to Lula's re-election, even with parties across the political spectrum. Despite these efforts, polls show declining support for Lula in the North ahead of the 2026 election.

item.title: Presidentes do TSE e dos TREs projetam metas para as Eleições 2026
item.description: Minister Cármen Lúcia, president of the TSE, presented a management balance with record biometric registration levels and outlined the strategic planning for the 2026 Elections in a meeting with the presidents of the 22 TREs. The meeting reinforced goals of security and technological expansion to ensure vote integrity and democratic transparency, focusing on coordination with security forces and the Federal Police to combat electoral crimes. Nunes Marques will assume the TSE Presidency in May.

item.title: TSE tem maioria para cassar governador de Roraima e tornar ex-governador inelegível
item.description: The TSE formed a majority to remove Roraima Governor Edilson Damião and declare former Governor Antonio Denarium ineligible for eight years due to abuse of power in distributing basic food baskets and housing benefits during the 2022 campaign. The ruling was suspended and will resume on Thursday, the 30th. Denarium had previously resigned to run for the Senate, allowing Damião to assume the governorship.

item.title: TSE cassa mandato de governador de Roraima e torna Antônio Denarium inelegível
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) annulled the mandate of former Roraima governor Antônio Denarium and declared him ineligible for eight years due to abuse of political and economic power in the 2022 elections, with a unanimous vote. Current interim governor Edilson Damião had his mandate revoked by a 6-1 majority for the same reasons, including the improper use of social programs like 'Cesta da Família' and 'Morar Melhor' to gain electoral advantage. The trial was suspended after Minister André Mendonça requested to present a vote complement, with the next session scheduled for April 30.

item.title: Caiado critica gestões do PT e diz que se Bolsonaro tivesse governado bem não teria perdido eleição
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticized the PT and Jair Bolsonaro's administrations, stating that if Bolsonaro had governed well, he would not have lost the 2022 election. He cited his 88% approval rating in Goiás and argued that Brazil's solution lies in good governance, moving beyond polarization and focusing on results, especially in agribusiness. Caiado also accused the Lula government of increasing bureaucracy and tax burden, hindering the country's potential for three annual harvests.

item.title: Com maioria para cassação, julgamento de ex-governador de RR é adiado
item.description: The TSE postponed the judgment that could cassate the ticket of Antonio Denarium and Edilson Damião, elected in 2022 for the government of Roraima, after reaching a majority of 6 to 1 in favor of cassation. The postponement was made to allow Minister André Mendonça to adjust his vote before the session resumes on Thursday (April 30, 2026). The Court rejected the idea of separating the effects of the conviction, maintaining that the ticket is indivisible in majoritarian elections.

item.title: Gestão Tarcísio propõe salário-mínimo estadual de R$ 1.874, com reajuste de 3,9%
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas proposed raising São Paulo's state minimum wage to R$1,874, a 3.9% increase. The bill was submitted to the state legislature and awaits approval by deputies before taking effect.

item.title: Marco Aurélio Bellizze toma posse como ministro substituto do TSE
item.description: Minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze of the Superior Court of Justice (STJ) was sworn in as a substitute minister of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on January 28, filling one of the seats reserved for STJ members following the end of Minister Isabel Gallotti’s biennium in November 2025. The ceremony, led by TSE President Minister Cármen Lúcia, emphasized the importance of ensuring secure, integral, and transparent elections in 2026. Attendees included TSE and STJ officials, OAB representatives, and the magistrate’s family and friends.

item.title: Moraes alfineta Zema e vê “escada eleitoral” em críticas ao STF
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes criticized politicians who use attacks on the STF as an 'electoral ladder' to compensate for lack of electoral viability, specifically referencing former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema, whose voting intentions ranged from 3.1% to 3.8% according to an AtlasIntel poll. Moraes argued that such candidacies avoid discussing proposals in areas like health, education, and security, opting instead for verbal aggression against the Judiciary. The criticism follows satirical videos by Zema that prompted Moraes to suggest his inclusion in the Fake News Inquiry.

item.title: PSDB critica manifesto do PT e diz que partido tem “ideias antigas”
item.description: The PSDB criticized the PT's 8th Congress manifesto, published on April 26, 2026, accusing the party of promoting an 'outdated socialism' and seeking to abolish the Fiscal Responsibility Law (LRF). The manifesto, drafted by the CNB trend, proposes seven structural reforms under 'democratic socialism' and aims to support Lula's re-election in 2026, though the detailed government plan will only be developed during the campaign. The PSDB also links the Lula government to losses at Correios, citing an R$8.5 billion deficit in 2025, and claims the PT uses criticism of privatizations to hide public management failures.

item.title: Governadora do DF pede reunião com Lula ainda esta semana para tratar do socorro ao BRB
item.description: The governor of the Federal District, Celina Leão, requested a meeting with President Lula this week to seek a National Treasury guarantee for a R$6.6 billion loan to the Bank of Brasília (BRB), aimed at resolving the bank’s patrimonial crisis. The request comes despite the DF holding a 'C' rating in the Capag fiscal capacity index, which bars the Union from acting as guarantor on new credit operations. The GDF states the measure is part of a broader plan to ensure BRB’s stability, as the bank is controlled by the state government.

item.title: Marcos Pontes pede abstenção para identificar opositores de Jorge Messias
item.description: Senator Marcos Pontes (PL-SP) urged senators to abstain in the vote on Jorge Messias' STF nomination to make opposition visible, as secret voting allows concealed support. He explained that the Senate's electronic panel highlights voters in yellow and those merely present in white, making abstention a clear signal of dissent. Abstentions do not affect the required quorum of 41 favorable votes out of 81 senators for approval.

item.title: Lula manda indireta a Trump ao assinar decreto que promulga acordo UE-Mercosul
item.description: President Lula signed the decree promulgating the EU-Mercosul trade agreement, which enters into force on May 1st, eliminating tariffs on most goods between the blocs. He framed the agreement as an example of democracy, multilateralism, and cordial international relations, making an indirect reference to U.S. President Donald Trump amid global trade tensions.

item.title: Governo Lula estuda até 99% de desconto em dívidas do Fies e benefício para adimplentes
item.description: The Lula government is considering granting up to 99% discount on Fies student loan debts, with varying conditions based on debtor profile, including benefits for those current on payments. The initiative aims to reduce nearly R$ 58 billion in delinquencies, improve the fund's cash flow, generate at least R$ 1 billion in revenue, and deliver significant social impact.

item.title: Senado aprova cadastro nacional de agressores de mulheres
item.description: The Senate approved a bill to create a National Registry of Persons Convicted of Violence Against Women, containing personal data such as full name, CPF, RG, photo, fingerprints, and address, accessible to police forces nationwide. The registry will be managed by the federal government and integrated with existing systems like the CNMP to improve monitoring of offenders and protection of victims. The bill, which includes offenses like femicide, rape, harassment, and psychological violence, now awaits presidential sanction.

item.title: Após encontro, Zema elogia Tarcísio e diz ter alinhamento, mas descarta pedir apoio à candidatura: 'nem toco nesse assunto'
item.description: Romeu Zema, Novo party's pre-candidate for president, praised São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas after their meeting at Agrishow, highlighting alignment on values such as anti-corruption and equal application of the law. Despite the praise, Zema ruled out seeking Tarcísio's support, citing the governor's prior commitment to the Bolsonaro family in Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign. Zema also noted his August 2023 meeting with Jair Bolsonaro, arguing that more right-wing candidates strengthen the political field.

item.title: O fim da vantagem? Lula e Flávio empatam no 2º turno e Zema vira ameaça real.
item.description: AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll shows a technical tie in the 2026 runoff, with Flávio Bolsonaro narrowly ahead of Lula at 47.8% to 47.5%. Bolsonaro's growth was minimal (0.2 points), while Zema emerges as a genuine threat. Despite the narrow lead, the margin of error keeps the outcome uncertain.

item.title: Wellington Dias volta ao Senado por aprovação de Jorge Messias
item.description: Wellington Dias (PT-PI) temporarily stepped down as Minister of Social Development to return to the Senate and participate in the confirmation hearing of Jorge Messias, Lula’s nominee to the Supreme Federal Court. He is replacing his alternate, Jussara Lima (PSD-PI), and is expected to return to the ministry on April 30, with Osmar Júnior serving as interim executive secretary. The government has mobilized support, including releasing R$11.7 billion in amendments, to secure Messias’ approval, which requires 14 votes in the CCJ and 41 in the full Senate.

item.title: Lula planeja anunciar novo Desenrola em pronunciamento na TV sobre Dia do Trabalho
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva plans to announce a new Desenrola program in a nationwide radio and TV broadcast aimed at reducing population indebtedness, during his Workers' Day address scheduled for the evening of April 30. The initiative seeks to expand credit access and renegotiate debts for vulnerable families.

item.title: Relator vota para suspender mandato de deputados que fizeram motim na Câmara
item.description: The rapporteur of the Chamber of Deputies' Ethics Committee, Deputy Moses Rodrigues (União Brasil-CE), voted for a two-month suspension of the mandates of three lawmakers who stormed the Mesa Diretora during a riot in the chamber. The measure aims to hold accountable those involved in the institutional disorder incident.

item.title: Oposição aciona TCU e questiona uso de R$ 4,5 milhões em organização de acervo pessoal de Lula
item.description: The opposition's deputy leader in the Chamber, Sanderson (PL-RS), filed a representation with the TCU requesting an investigation into the use of R$ 4.5 million for organizing President Lula's personal archive. The action questions the legality and purpose of the public expenditure involved in the initiative.

item.title: Ministros do STF se preocupam com sabatina de Messias no Senado
item.description: Two STF ministers and court aides express concern over the possible rejection of Jorge Messias in his Senate confirmation hearing scheduled for April 28. What was once seen as a certain approval is now viewed as uncertain due to opposition from ministers like Flávio Dino and Alexandre de Moraes, as well as resistance from Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, who had no prior contact with Messias despite attending an event hosted by Cristiano Zanin.

item.title: Sóstenes promete reação a “golpe aplicado por Lula e Paes” no RJ
item.description: Federal deputy Sóstenes Cavalcante (PL-RJ) promised a proportional reaction to what he described as a coup carried out by the Judiciary, President Lula, and former Rio mayor Eduardo Paes, following a decision by Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin. He accused them of disrespecting the presidential succession line and claimed the action was coordinated among the three branches. The statement was made in a social media post on Tuesday, the 28th.

item.title: Ministro da França diz que acordo Mercosul-UE é “muito positivo”
item.description: French trade minister Nicolas Forissier called the Mercosul-EU agreement 'very positive', despite France's opposition due to sector-specific demands. The deal was signed in January 2026 and promulgated by Lula on April 28, 2026, while the EU is reviewing its legality in court for up to two years.

item.title: Áudio: Relator defende indicação de Messias; oposição diz que votará contra
item.description: The Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) is holding a hearing for Jorge Messias, the Attorney General of the Union, nominated by President Lula to the Supreme Federal Court (STF). Rapporteur Senator Weverton (PDT-MA) supports the nomination based on Messias' technical qualifications, while the opposition has declared it will vote against, citing concerns over the politicization of the Court. The committee vote will be followed by a plenary session later the same day, requiring 41 votes for approval.

item.title: Flávio é aconselhado a adotar tom equilibrado em sabatina de Messias
item.description: Allies of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) are advising him to adopt a respectful and balanced tone during the hearing of Jorge Messias before the Senate Constitution and Justice Committee on Wednesday, the 29th. The guidance aims to avoid confrontations and project an image of institutional responsibility.

item.title: Os comentários ácidos de Tarcísio e Zema sobre Gilmar Mendes na Agrishow
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema and São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas interacted casually at the Agrishow, referencing Zema's video series that criticizes STF ministers, especially Gilmar Mendes. Zema teased Tarcísio about being caricatured and defended free speech, while Tarcísio praised Zema's mineiro accent and suggested a coffee meetup. The exchange included indirect criticism of Gilmar Mendes, who had previously sought to include Zema in the fake news inquiry.

item.title: Por que operador do PCC quis pousar no Palácio dos Bandeirantes em 2022
item.description: João Gabriel de Mello Yamawaki, identified as a financial operator of the PCC, was authorized to land his helicopter at the Palácio dos Bandeirantes in March 2022 during João Doria’s administration to attend a São Paulo vs. Palmeiras match. He was targeted in Operation Contaminatio, which investigates the PCC’s 'political nucleus,' and is accused of illegally moving up to R$ 8 billion through the unauthorized digital bank 4TBANK. The Tarcísio de Freitas government denied any involvement, stating it has not authorized landings in his name since taking office in 2023.

item.title: Motta diz que cumpriu "todos os protocolos" ao deixar voo alvo da PF
item.description: Hugo Motta, president of the Chamber of Deputies, stated he followed all customs protocols when disembarking from a flight under investigation by the Federal Police for allegedly allowing unmonitored baggage entry from a Caribbean tax haven. He said he will await the PGR's statement and denied wrongdoing. The flight also carried Senator Ciro Nogueira and other lawmakers, and is linked to a businessman under scrutiny in the Bets CPI.

item.title: Suspensão de multas do free flow 'desinflama' debate e tira o assunto da arena eleitoral, diz setor
item.description: The federal government suspended for 200 days the fines applied to drivers who did not pay free flow tolls, a measure seen by the road sector as a way to deflate a debate contaminated by political pressures. The decision reduces tension around the issue, temporarily removing it from the electoral agenda.

item.title: “Vaga no STF não é disputa presidencial”, diz relator de indicação de Messias
item.description: Senator Weverton Rocha, rapporteur of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, stated that the Supreme Court vacancy should not be treated as a presidential dispute and that the CCJ hearing will take place this Wednesday at 9 a.m. He expressed confidence in approval with an estimated 45 favorable votes, despite resistance from PL, Novo, and part of PP, and emphasized that the process is being conducted institutionally by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre.

item.title: Lula assina decreto que promulga acordo UE-Mercosul
item.description: President Lula signed the decree promulgating the EU-Mercosur trade agreement, which enters into force on May 1, 2026. The treaty will eliminate tariffs on 91% of European goods for Mercosur within up to 15 years and 95% of Mercosul goods for the EU within up to 12 years, covering 31 countries and a combined population of 720 million.

item.title: Desoneração da folha: PGR se manifesta a favor da solução de Zanin
item.description: The Attorney General’s Office (PGR) supported Minister Cristiano Zanin’s position in the STF, which upholds the constitutionality of the 2024 injunction requiring compensation for revenue loss in payroll tax exemptions. Zanin maintained that Law 14.784/2023, which extended the exemption without specifying compensations, is unconstitutional, but refrained from assessing the political agreement between the government and Congress or the gradual reoneração law (Law 14.973/2024). The PGR emphasized that Zanin’s vote ensures legal security and observes budgetary sustainability, even if the case may lose its object.

item.title: “Do jeito que está, não vão deixar”, diz PF sobre faixa com “ladrão”
item.description: Federal Police approached a resident of Presidente Prudente (SP) for displaying a banner with the word 'thief' near an event with President Lula, stating it could constitute a crime against honor. The resident claimed the message was generic and made on private property without naming the president, but agents said superiors would not view it as protected speech. The PF confirmed the action was based on suspicion of honor offense, in line with security protocols for authorities.

item.title: Construção civil tem a maior inflação para abril em 16 anos
item.description: Construction sector inflation (INCC-M) reached 1.04% in April, the highest for the month since 2010, driven by petroleum-derived input costs and potential Middle East conflict effects. Cbic warns the trend may worsen in May, threatening government housing programs like Minha Casa, Minha Vida and PAC, despite an extra R$20 billion fund and a target of 3 million homes by 2026.

item.title: STF vai julgar queixa-crime de procuradora contra Bolsonaro por calúnia
item.description: The Brazilian Supreme Federal Court (STF) recognized its jurisdiction to hear a criminal complaint filed by prosecutor Monique Cheker Mendes against former President Jair Bolsonaro for defamation, after he claimed in 2022 that she 'fabricated evidence' in a 2012 environmental investigation. The ruling relies on a 2025 STF precedent establishing that functional jurisdiction for crimes committed in office persists even after leaving office, reversing prior interpretation. The Court ordered both parties to declare within 10 days whether they are interested in a conciliation hearing.
